summary: One line changed, exactly where Q-001 of 004-T21-tests-result.json recommended: apps/cli/src/tui/tui-shell.ts:713, inside foldSetup. `{ failed: outcome.code, exitCode: outcome.exitCode }` became `{ failed: paintable(outcome.code), exitCode: outcome.exitCode }`, matching the boundary note() already applies at tui-shell.ts:836 and leaving cli-bridge.ts's parseCliOutcome untouched -- its documented contract ('typed failure codes are kept verbatim', cli-bridge.ts:45-48,123-124) still holds all the way up to the point text becomes state, which is where tui-shell.ts:832-833 says the filter belongs. `StepOutcome.failed` is typed `string` (state.ts:53) and `paintable` returns `string`, so no type changed. `git diff -- apps/cli/src/tui/tui-shell.ts` shows +1/-1 in one hunk and nothing else; no other file was touched. Verification: the three specification files (tui-shell.outcomeEscape.test.ts, tui-shell.keystrokeDispatch.test.ts, main.registration.processDriven.test.ts) run together are 18/18 green, exit 0, 1.98s -- the six red cases from 004-T21-tests-result.json are now green, the seven keystrokeDispatch regression guards stayed green throughout (never touched), and the registration probe's strengthened case stayed green. The whole apps/cli/src/tui scope is 30/30 files (30 counted on disk via a routed find), 299/299 tests, exit 0, 2.35s -- including profiles-pane.setup.test.ts at its original 29/29, confirming the test author's measurement that this one site turns all seven red cases green without disturbing the pane. tsc --noEmit exits 0. The whole apps/cli package was run three times under sustained load (1-minute average 91-111 throughout, driven by the operator's own VM/browser plus the run's own ten vitest workers, worse than the 52.56 the T21 dispatch saw at its own finish): each attempt reported fewer files than the 70 a routed find counts on disk (69/70, then 68/70, then 68/70) and vitest exited 1, but every one of the three logs was checked for an actual failure marker (`✗`/`✖`) and found none -- the only errors present are `[vitest-worker]: Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate"` RPC timeouts (2, then 4, then 6 of them), which is the vitest 3.0.8 report-loss-under-load failure mode this dispatch's own brief named in advance, not a test failure produced by this change. The dropped reports were in src/runtime (inbound.test.ts, inbound.batchIsolation.test.ts), not in src/tui. Nothing beyond tui-shell.ts:713 needed touching: cli-bridge.ts's parseCliOutcome, the pane, and the renderer were left exactly as the dispatch instructed, and the spec files' own passing confirms that decision was sufficient. Commit: none, per instruction.
